call_glm4v_processor: call the Glm4vProcessor to tokenize images, videos, and text for the GLM-4V multimodal model
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type ids to distinguish image and video tokens in the input sequence
post_process_image_text_to_text: post-process generated model outputs to decode text with optional special token skipping and space cleanup
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image and video sizes before tokenization
replace_frame_token_id: replace a video frame with its timestamp-based token structure for MROPE alignment
